name: Checkmarx
description: Static application security testing tool that scans source code to identify security vulnerabilities during development.

name: Dependabot
description: GitHub-integrated tool that automatically checks project dependencies for known vulnerabilities and opens pull requests to update them.

name: Ghidra
description: Open-source software reverse engineering framework developed by the NSA, used to disassemble and decompile binaries for security research and malware analysis.

name: Metasploit
description: Penetration testing framework used by security professionals to develop, test, and execute exploit code against target systems.

name: OpenSSL
description: Open-source toolkit that implements the SSL/TLS protocols and provides cryptographic functions used for secure communications.

name: Prisma Cloud
description: Cloud security platform that provides posture management, workload protection, and compliance monitoring across multi-cloud environments.

name: Snyk
description: Developer security platform that scans code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure-as-code for vulnerabilities, integrating into development workflows.

name: SonarQube
description: Open-source platform for continuous inspection of code quality, detecting bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells across many programming languages.

name: ThreatLocker
description: Endpoint security platform that uses application allowlisting, ringfencing, and access control to prevent unauthorized software execution and limit attack surfaces.

name: Veracode
description: Application security platform offering static, dynamic, and software composition analysis to find and remediate vulnerabilities in code.
